structured_output.summary: The diff implements Array.prototype.unshift in its stub file, following spec steps 1-6 in order. ToObject runs first, then LengthOfArrayLike and the 2^53-1 TypeError check inside the spec's argCount > 0 branch. The move loop uses HasProperty, Get, Set(throw=true) and DeletePropertyOrThrow, with ? propagation everywhere. Items are written with Set, then length is set and the result returned. There are no input-specific branches, no fallback values, and no swallowed errors. Each spec step is kept as a comment above its code. The only non-spec-step change is renaming the unused new_target parameter to _new_target, which is needed because it is no longer read. Dropping the trailing NOTE and "length" property comments from the doc block is cosmetic. The gate report shows 36 new passes and 0 regressions.
